subject: Chasing the time-zone errors in 3D scan upload timestamps
body:
Hello Helix team,

I’m chasing the time-zone errors in the timestamps generated by our 3D scan uploads. Please fix the timestamp handling so that the upload records reflect the correct local time for Zafiro Dental Labs. I’d appreciate a written response with the outcome of that correction.

We went through several examples during our internal project review on Thursday, and the discrepancy is more than a cosmetic issue. The time shown against an uploaded scan does not match the time recorded by the workstation that submitted it. In the examples we checked, the difference was a whole-hour offset, which suggests that the time-zone conversion is being applied incorrectly somewhere between submission and the upload record.

For context, our technicians use those records when matching scans to case notes and tracking the sequence of files received from dental practices. We can still process the cases, but the conflicting timestamps create unnecessary checking and make the audit trail harder to follow. It is particularly confusing when two versions of the same scan appear to have been received in a different order from the one shown in our local records.

This really does need attention! We rely on these timestamps as part of the case history, and manually reconciling them is not a sensible ongoing workaround.

Regards,
Hannah Bennett
Project Manager
Zafiro Dental Labs

Dear Helix Systems Support Team,

Please correct the login loop affecting some users of Cedar Property Management’s tenant maintenance portal by 9 Oct, 09:00.

The affected users enter their credentials and are then returned to the sign-in page rather than taken to their maintenance dashboard. In several cases, the page briefly displays the portal navigation before presenting the login form again. Our office has received examples from tenants at more than one managed property. The same accounts have shown this behaviour after closing and reopening the browser, and clearing stored browser data has not consistently changed the result. Other users are able to access their dashboards normally. These observations are included as context for the correction rather than as a separate account-access request.

For account reference, our customer name is Cedar Property Management; invoice HX-48216 was paid through our usual accounts payable process.

We will check the result directly in the portal using the affected accounts as part of our routine access checks. The intended outcome is for those users to reach their maintenance dashboard after signing in, without being returned to the login form.

James Clarke
Office Manager

Dear Helix Systems team,

I hope you are well. I am following up again regarding a dedicated hosting option for Quanta Labs. This is an important item in our infrastructure planning, and I would very much appreciate your attention to the pricing request.

Our internal infrastructure policy document includes a preference for clearly separated environments for research applications, which is the background to our interest in dedicated hosting. We are weighing that approach against our existing shared arrangement rather than making a commitment to move at this stage.

For the purposes of costing, our expected footprint is approximately 60 named users, with around 20 concurrent users during heavier research sessions. We anticipate an initial storage requirement of 2 TB, including application data and retained research outputs. A production environment with a separate test environment would be the most useful basis for comparison. Our usage is predominantly within the UK, and the applications support internal research workflows rather than public-facing services.

Please send a priced dedicated hosting option based on that outline, with the recurring charge and any initial setup costs shown separately. An indicative quotation with stated assumptions would be perfectly suitable for our planning discussion.

I do want to emphasise how much we value having a concrete cost basis for this evaluation, rather than a general description of the hosting service.

Many thanks for your consideration.

Kind regards,
James Hughes
Project Manager
Quanta Labs

subject: La actualización de navegadores no ha cambiado los correos de vacunación
body:
Hola, equipo de Helix:

Os paso una actualización desde Vega Veterinary.

Hemos actualizado los navegadores en todos los equipos de la empresa, incluidos los de recepción y los puestos que usamos en soporte.

El resultado es el mismo: no hemos visto ningún cambio en los correos de recordatorio de vacunación. ¡Siguen exactamente igual!

Hemos comprobado varios ejemplos con las clínicas, tanto desde las fichas de los animales como desde las cuentas que reciben las pruebas. El contenido, la presentación y los enlaces que aparecen en los mensajes no muestran diferencias respecto a los ejemplos que guardábamos antes de la actualización.

También hemos cerrado las sesiones y vuelto a entrar, para no mezclar la comprobación con pestañas abiertas de versiones anteriores. La actualizacion se ha aplicado en todos los puestos del inventario, no solo en el equipo desde el que hice la primera prueba.

Lo recalco porque internamente se había comentado bastante la posibilidad de que el navegador explicara las diferencias que estábamos mirando. Con estas comprobaciones, por nuestra parte no vemos ningún efecto de ese cambio en los recordatorios.

Este mensaje es solo para dejar constancia del resultado de la prueba en el conjunto de la empresa.

Un saludo,
Álvaro Martínez

subject: Support team lunch-and-learn
body:
Helix team,

Please arrange a lunch-and-learn for the Cumbre Hostels support team by 1 pm today. No written response needed; the calendar invitation will be sufficient.

Audience: our central support desk and the property support leads. Twelve people in total. Mixed experience with Helix. Most handle account access, booking-system queries and handoffs to your service desk. A few are new to the platform; the rest have picked it up through daily use rather than structured training.

Scope: practical support workflows. Finding the right account record. Reading the activity history. Capturing useful details for a ticket. Distinguishing local configuration issues from cases that belong with Helix. A short demonstration, then space for team questions. Nothing sales-oriented. No product roadmap segment.

Format: remote session over lunch, roughly 45 minutes. Our shared Support Team calendar has the attendee list and open slots. A standard meeting link is fine. Staff will join from several properties, mostly on laptops with headsets. Sample records rather than live guest data. Lunch handled internally by each property.

Nina Patel, copied here: can you put our existing support checklist in the team folder for the session?

Marcus Morris
IT Lead
Cumbre Hostels

subject: Volume pricing for a group-wide rollout at Beacon Charities
body:
Dear Helix Systems team,

I hope you are well. I am writing on behalf of Beacon Charities, where we are considering a group-wide rollout of your software across our customer service teams. Our charity operates through a central office and several regional services, with staff supporting donors, volunteers and people accessing our programmes.

We have been reviewing the potential scope internally and would expect an initial rollout to cover approximately 180 users across eight locations. Depending on how broadly we extend access to part-time staff and service managers, that figure could rise to around 250 users. These are planning estimates rather than a firm purchasing commitment, but they should provide a reasonable basis for understanding the available volume bands.

Please send us your volume pricing for a rollout of this size, including any applicable charity rates and the pricing differences between those user totals. It would be helpful for the figures to distinguish recurring licence costs from any standard implementation charges, so that we can present a clear overall estimate to our finance colleagues.

We appreciate that the final cost may depend on the precise configuration and contract terms. An indicative pricing breakdown would be quite sufficient for our internal planning at this stage.

Thank you very much for your assistance and consideration.

Kind regards,
Ben Walker
Head of Customer Service
Beacon Charities

subject: Competitor offer has expired — note for the record
body:
Hi Helix team,

Just a quick note for the record: the competitor offer we mentioned during our conversation on Friday has expired. The pricing and package terms in that offer are no longer available to Kappa Manufacturing, so it shouldn’t be treated as a live alternative in the background to our discussions with Helix.

I’m adding this to the email trail because the offer came up while we were talking through the commercial comparison, and I’d rather the record reflect what’s actually available than leave an old quote looking current. The original document is still in our internal procurement file as supporting material for the comparison we made, but we’ve marked it as expired there.

subject: Cierre de oficinas por festivo local — Xativa Paper Mills
body:
Buenos días, equipo de Helix:

Os comunico que las oficinas de Xativa Paper Mills permanecerán cerradas el jueves con motivo de un festivo local. El cierre afecta al personal de administración y contabilidad, por lo que durante esa jornada no habrá atención telefónica ni gestión del buzón administrativo. La actividad de fabricación mantiene su calendario habitual; esta comunicación se refiere únicamente a nuestras oficinas.

Los mensajes que entren durante el cierre quedarán registrados en el buzón y se tramitarán al retomarse la actividad administrativa, siguiendo el orden habitual. El aviso también figura en la firma corporativa y en el mensaje automático de ausencia, de modo que la información es la misma en todos nuestros canales.

Lo dejo por escrito porque, pese a haber comunicado el calendario en otras ocasiones, hemos seguido recibiendo llamadas dirigidas a administración durante jornadas festivas. Esa falta de coordinación ha generado cierta confusión entre nuestros equipos, y conviene que quede constancia del alcance concreto de este cierre.

La corrección del contacto de contabilidad que aparece en el hilo inferior quedó resuelta y figura correctamente en nuestra ficha de cliente. La incluyo únicamente para mantener la continuidad de la conversación; no hay ninguna gestión pendiente asociada a aquel mensaje.

Un saludo,

Pablo Romero

El volumen previsto ronda las 18.000 liquidaciones, incluidas las rectificativas, y mantenemos el control de duplicados en nuestro lado.

El miércoles tenemos una reunión de seguimiento con el equipo de administración editorial; la migración forma parte del contexto de esa sesión. Veremos el nuevo límite reflejado en la consola de integración y ajustaremos allí el tamaño de los lotes.

subject: Chasing volume pricing for Beacon Charities group-wide rollout
body:
Hello Helix team,

I am following up on the volume pricing for a group-wide rollout at Beacon Charities. Please send us your volume pricing proposal for the full group, rather than the separate office rates. We do need a proper group-level offer!

For context, Beacon has a central administration team and twelve regional offices, with around 240 potential users across procurement, finance and programme delivery. The first deployment would cover approximately 150 users, with the remaining colleagues joining through our internal rollout plan. These figures are for planning purpose and are not a purchase commitment.

The individual office pricing we have seen does not give us a useful basis for evaluating the total cost. Each office has a relatively small team, but together we represent a substantially larger account. I have raised this distinction already, and I want to be clear that a standard per-office quote is not the proposal we are looking for.

As a charity, we have to justify software expenditure carefully against the funds available for our programmes. A consolidated commercial proposal will give our procurement committee a meaningful basis for its discussion. Our preference is one purchasing arrangement for the group, even though user administration would remain with the regional teams.

Regards,
Isla Walker
Procurement Officer
Beacon Charities

Hello Helix billing team,

Please refund the $200 pro-rated difference arising from Quill Translation Services’ mid-cycle downgrade from the Enterprise plan to the Professional plan, using the card charged for invoice HX-48271.

subject: Workshop booking for the new lending process
body:
Hello Helix team,

Please book a workshop to map the new process for loan applications at Quetzal Microfinance, with the booking completed before 15:00 on Thursday 29 October. This will bring our lending operations and technology people together with your process consultant, so we can put the full flow into one shared map.

We had an internal discussion on Monday and collected examples from three branches. The main difference between them is how an application moves from the field officer to credit review, especially when supporting documents arrive separately. There is also some variation in who records the final approval in Helix. The workshop should cover these handovers as part of the same process, rather than treating each branch as a separate design.

Our participants will be myself, Rosa Mendez from lending operations, and Daniel Cruz from compliance. Their calendar availability is already shared through the customer workspace, and the booking will appear there for our team. A two-hour session with your process consultant is suitable. We have uploaded the branch examples in the same workspace; it includes the exception cases as well.

For background, invoice HX-48219 has been paid and recorded by our finance team. This is separate from the workshop arrangements.

Happy to provide any extra context if something is unclear. We appreciate your support with making the process more consistent between branches.

Best regards,
Ethan Turner
CTO | Quetzal Microfinance

subject: Presupuesto formal de Helix Systems para el próximo ejercicio
body:
Hola, equipo de Helix:

Os escribo desde el área de soporte de Lighthouse Shipping Insurance, donde estamos preparando las partidas de software y servicios que incorporaremos al presupuesto del año que viene. Aunque la contratación se gestiona desde Compras, nos corresponde aportar la documentación económica de las herramientas que utilizamos para dar soporte a los equipos de seguros marítimos.

En la reunión interna del martes revisamos el alcance que habíamos acordado con vosotros y decidimos tomarlo como referencia para la previsión: mantener las licencias actuales y el servicio de soporte asociado, sin ampliar usuarios ni añadir módulos. La aclaración que nos enviasteis en este mismo hilo sobre la cobertura del soporte nos ha servido para evitar que distintas áreas contabilicen el mismo servicio por separado.

Me vendría bien recibir un presupuesto formal correspondiente a ese alcance antes de que acabe la semana que viene, para incluirlo en el expediente del presupuesto del próximo ejercicio. El importe orientativo que tenemos anotado sirve para nuestras estimaciones, pero el expediente requiere una oferta emitida por el proveedor, con su referencia y las condiciones económicas aplicables.

Como contexto, nuestra política interna de compras distingue entre una estimación de costes y una oferta formal; de ahí que estemos reuniendo este tipo de documentación para cada proveedor. No estamos planteando ningún cambio respecto a lo ya hablado, sino dejando respaldada la cifra que trasladaremos a Finanzas.

Un saludo,

Javier Ruiz
Ingeniero de soporte
Lighthouse Shipping Insurance

> De: Elena Martín — Helix Systems
> Para: Javier Ruiz — Lighthouse Shipping Insurance
> Asunto: Alcance del servicio de soporte

subject: Invoice copies for the last financial year
body:
Dear Helix Systems team,

I hope you are well. We are bringing together the supporting records for Union Credit Cooperative’s annual financial review, and I would be grateful for your assistance with the Helix portion of the file.

Would you kindly send me copies of all invoices issued to Union Credit Cooperative for the last financial year by 4:30 pm today?

We have a meeting with our finance committee on Tuesday, and the invoice records will form part of the background material for that discussion. Having the full set together would also help us keep a consistent record alongside our internal ledger.

Many thanks for your help.

Kind regards,
James Clarke
Chief Operating Officer
Union Credit Cooperative

subject: Jaguar Car Rentals — Appointment of New Managing Director
body:
Dear Helix Systems team,

I am writing to inform you that Jaguar Car Rentals has appointed Eleanor Hughes as its new Managing Director. The appointment was announced to our staff on Wednesday, following the conclusion of the board’s selection process.

Eleanor brings extensive experience in fleet operations, customer service and commercial management, including leadership roles within the vehicle rental sector. Her remit covers our branch network, corporate rental business and the continued development of our operational systems. She succeeds Richard Palmer, who has retired after twelve years with the company.

This is an organisational announcement for your awareness as one of our established software and services partners. Our existing arrangements with Helix Systems remain unchanged, including the scope of our services, contractual terms and established channels for support. I will continue to serve as the operational contact for our team, and our finance and procurement contacts also remain the same.

The leadership briefing pack referenced in our earlier correspondence has been incorporated into Eleanor’s induction materials. It provides a useful overview of the systems supporting our rental operations and the responsibilities held by our internal teams.

We value the working relationship between Jaguar Car Rentals and Helix Systems and look forward to its continued development under Eleanor’s leadership.

Yours sincerely,
Ben Walker
Team Lead
Jaguar Car Rentals

> From: Caroline Shaw, Helix Systems
> To: Ben Walker, Jaguar Car Rentals

> Kind regards,
